$comment: Declarative topology — the single source of truth for which runtime images exist, how they deploy, and which alerts cover them. tools/check_topology_contracts.py DERIVES its checks from this file and proves two exhaustiveness properties: (1) every `FROM runtime-base AS <target>` in services/mail-server/Dockerfile must appear here (class build-only is allowed, silence is not), and (2) every non-infrastructure service in docker-compose.prod.yml must map to an entry. A future runtime target or compose service cannot silently escape the topology gate.

services.notes: SSR console + control plane + REST API

services.notes: open/click/unsubscribe edge service

services.name: ha
services.notes: HA failover/health-check/backup/replication orchestrator (crates/ha, ha-server :4300). DECLARED GAP: the binary exposes NO scrapeable /metrics endpoint (only the JSON GET /health liveness route), so no Prometheus alert can be declared yet — adding an alert requires a metrics exporter in the crate first. Dockerfile/compose healthchecks probe the real GET /health endpoint.

services.name: isolation
services.notes: Tenant isolation service (crates/isolation, isolation-server :4500): org/workspace/quota APIs, per-tenant encryption keys, rate limiting, isolation audit. DECLARED GAP: no scrapeable /metrics endpoint (JSON GET /health only) — no Prometheus alert can be declared yet. Production start REQUIRES the isolation_internal_api_key + tenant_encryption_key Docker secrets (binary exits 78 without them).

services.name: ai-embeddings
services.notes: image is built but intentionally not deployed — declared fact, not an omission
